doc.description:
Time lapse of GeoColor images from NOAA's GOES-East satellite for the month of August 2021, in 8K UHD (4320p) resolution. Includes Hurricane Ida, which reached hurricane strength on Aug 27, made landfall in Louisiana as a Category 4 on Aug 29, and weakened to a tropical storm on Aug 30. 
Image collation and video processing by Raw Space. Source images are 10848x10848 resolution. One image captured every 10 minutes, played back at 24 frames per second. 1 second of video represents 4 hours of time.
GeoColor daytime view has been color-corrected to approximate what the human eye would see. GeoColor nighttime view is a composite of static city lights data, white high-altitude/ice clouds, and blue low altitude/liquid-water clouds.
GeoColor was developed jointly by Colorado State University's Cooperative Institute for Research in the Atmosphere (CIRA); and the National Oceanographic and Atmospheric Administration's (NOAA) Center for Satellite Applications and Research (STAR), Regional and Mesoscale Meteorology Branch (RAMMB). This imagery is public domain. If used, credit should be given to NOAA/CIRA.
